shots.image_prompt: Cinematic photo, a friendly young woman presenter with long black hair and a white blouse, in a cozy living room at night, standing next to a small black home server box with a blue glowing ring on a wooden shelf, above it floats a holographic blue planet Earth covered by a fine glowing grid of square cells, warm lamp light mixed with cyan hologram glow, 35mm
shots.prompt: The young woman with long black hair and a white blouse looks at the camera and smiles, the holographic grid planet slowly rotates above the small home server. She says in French, warm and confident: 'Voici ma station Astroport, chez moi.' Soft electronic hum, gentle ambient music.

The young woman with long black hair and a white blouse points at one glowing square cell on the holographic planet, which lights up brighter. She says in French: 'Chaque case de la planète est une UMAP, un morceau de territoire.' Soft electronic hum, gentle ambient music.
